name: solidity-nft-escrow-market
title: Escrowed NFT marketplace
description: ERC721 custody listings with fixed token prices, royalty caps, cancellation and pull-based sale proceeds.
assumptions: ERC721 escrow and standard ERC20 settlement. Royalties are seller-declared and capped by the total payout budget, not authoritative ERC2981 royalty enforcement. Direct unsolicited NFT transfers are not recoverable; only list() creates tracked listings.
